svg.title: The specimen trained from 120 seeds: plain Adam keeps leaving the floor; a cosine schedule lets it stay.
svg.desc: Loss (logarithmic, 0.05 to 2.2 nats) against step (linear, 0 to 2000). Ink: Adam (β₂ 0.95, no weight decay, no clipping) at constant η = 0.02. Value ink: the same with 20 warmup steps and cosine decay to 0.002. Seeds 1–120. After step 300 the constant-rate runs show 977 sudden jumps of more than 50% between consecutive steps.
